name: Frittlingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Frittlingen (a chequy chief and a black letter S on white).
history: Municipal flag of Frittlingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Frittlingen arms — chequy chief and letter S
